result_text:
The three latest-orders queries in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` now leave out archived orders, the same way they already leave out cancelled ones. The affected methods are `findLatestOrders`, `findLatestOrdersByRegion` and `findLatestOrdersByCustomer`. Each got the `NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_archive …)` filter that the other order queries already use.

I ran the tests matching `*Latest*` and `*Archive*`, and they passed. I did not add a test for your Alpha/Beta example or run it separately.

The javadoc on those methods still says only "cancelled orders are left out". I left it unchanged.
